summary: An Airswift blog post (December 11, 2020, written by JC Cornell, Renewables and Growth Marketing Manager) offering eleven practical tips for planning the year ahead despite uncertainty caused by 2020's disruptions. The tips cover separating professional and personal plans, reviewing the past year, making SMART goals with backup plans, keeping a not-to-do list, establishing routines and quarterly reviews, booking vacation, pursuing side projects, celebrating wins, leaving schedule space, adjusting attitude, and allowing flexibility. The post ends with a promotion of Airswift's recruitment services.
one_line: Airswift blog post giving eleven practical tips for planning the year ahead amid uncertainty, from goal-setting and routines to vacation and flexibility.
key_facts: The post '11 simple things you can do to plan for the year ahead' by Airswift is dated December 11, 2020.
The post was written by JC Cornell, Renewables and Growth Marketing Manager at Airswift.
The post states that for most people, 2020 started with set budgets, plans and goals, which were then shaken up and flipped upside down.
Tip 1 advises planning professional and personal years separately, noting that 'you only have 24 hours in a day'.
Tip 2 recommends reviewing the past year by identifying three large wins and three areas that needed work.
Tip 3 advises thinking of exactly where you want to be by 31 December of next year and having a plan B and perhaps a vague plan C.
Tip 3 says to develop SMART goals that are achievable, very specific and realistic, and to plan 'only for the year ahead, not the next five'.
Tip 4 describes a not-to-do list as getting rid of tasks that prevent greater productivity, and says tasks should be delegated to save time.
Tip 5 recommends adding recurring tasks to the calendar on repeat and scheduling time for quarterly reviews to monitor goals.
Tip 6 advises booking holidays in advance and says 'You have a vacation for a reason – use it!'.
Tip 7 encourages working on a side project for sheer enjoyment, since not everything meaningful can be measured.
Tip 9 recommends reschedule hour-long meetings to 45 minutes and avoiding back-to-back scheduling.
Tip 10 states 'you cannot control the outcome of your year, you can control how you react'.
Tip 11 says a plan for the year ahead is only as good as one's ability to understand that things happen outside one's control.
The post closes by offering Airswift's recruitment services to businesses needing technical staff, contract workers or permanent hires.
